description: This file defines a React component named HoverDetailPanel used for showing detailed information about a selected node in a Workflow Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG). It manages positioning, visibility, and rendering of icons, labels, and additional technical details related to workflow nodes.

methods.name: getStatusIcon
methods.description: Returns a React icon element based on the workflow node status

methods.name: formatDuration
methods.description: Formats a duration in milliseconds into a human-readable string

methods.name: formatTimestamp
methods.description: Converts a timestamp string into a localized time string

methods.name: humanizeText
methods.description: Converts snake_case and dash-separated text into a human-readable Camel Case string
